notes.title: Unable To Purchase Game From Steam Or Redeem Codes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

As you may know, the Steam page is now up and running... However we are facing some technical issues that we are looking to resolve as soon as possible. 

If you want to be alerted when these issues are resolved, please email us at support@excalibur-publishing.com with the subject line "Shoppe Keep"..... We will email you as soon as we confirm all these issues have been addressed.

The major issues are below:

1. The download depot's are not active and means anyone who has the game can not download the files if the game is not on their machine (If you have Shoppe Keep currently installed, please do not uninstall!)

All these issues are now Steam related and we are in touch with Steam to try and fix this technical issue.

Many thanks for all of your patience,  I hope we can resolve these issues very soon! Please do keep checking back with us as we are doing everything we can to get Shoppe Keep up and running.

All the best,
Chris

notes.title: Welcome to 2016! Content ID Issue Resolved! New Faces For Customers And Progression System
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have just a little bit of news to share today.

First, I’d like to let everyone know that we will soon be uploading a build which will remove the Christmas theme for Shoppe keep. We hope you all had fun with the game over the holidays and hope that you continue to enjoy the game into 2016.

Secondly, we have finally resolved the Content ID system that was put in place by error. We have made our thoughts on this system well known and feel that they have no place in today’s gaming climate. We love youtubers and have a lot of respect for the players who make interesting content which also helps to spread news about our game. I’d like to thank Daniel Romeros, our musician for Shoppe Keep to help resolve this issue, it took many phone calls and emails but the content ID system has now been removed.

This means that anyone wishing to monetise from any videos of Shoppe keep can of course do so without being at risk of any copyright notices from now on.  

Thirdly we will be continuing to work on Shoppe Keep as usual. I will aim to share some more news very soon, but for a quick tease; our artist has been working on the customers. They will soon have different types of hair, as well as a new lip system which will soon change in game so customers will be more alive than ever before.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Orb1soH.png[/img]
 
Finally I’d like to address some thoughts from the community for the most recent update. We have read every every post and are very pleased that we have such an active and supportive community. The developer Arvydas would like to make just a brief announcement on some thoughts players have had regarding a free play mode.

“We will not be making a totally free mode as we feel that it contradicts the vision that we as developers have. We are sorry for those who do not enjoy this decision, but we will be trying to add more options that will allow players to customise their gaming experience to have some of its features unlock faster or far easier.”

We do feel that our weakest link is a decent tutorial, this is something that we will be aiming to rectify soon and hope that we can make the progression more satisfying than before for all players.

We hope you all have an awesome 2016 and you can bet that we’ll be working hard to refine improve and expand Shoppe Keep.

notes.title: ChangeLog 12.24.2016 - Difficulty, Skill Trees And K Points
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

A quick update today, we took your suggestions on board regarding progression and the new skill system based on the update from the 22nd of December. If you've not seen the update from 22nd December, check the link below:

http://steamcommunity.com/games/381120/announcements/detail/743456785774860775

We want to take a better look at everything in the new year once we return fully after the Christmas period. However, we have decided to upload a new update to fix a couple of bugs and to add a new drop down menu to the options screen. A difficulty selector.

This can only be accessed in the main menu options menu, it can not be activated in the middle of a game. Based on the difficulty selected, players may earn more K points from which to upgrade their shoppe and select skills.

It is wise to reset your progress using the options menu as early on, you can level up faster and upon reaching new levels you will be given a large amount of k points.

Earlier today I did some tests regarding progression and how much k points you can earn per each difficulty during the first day.  Please see below:

[h1]Very easy:[/h1]
120 k points
A shoppe featuring just three pedestals and Selling the following items at 126% - Frost resist and health potion
Reached Level 3

[h1]Easy[/h1]
80 K points
A shoppe featuring just three pedestals and Selling the following items at 126% - Frost resist and health potion
Reached Level 3

[h1]Challenge[/h1]
53 K points
A shoppe featuring just three pedestals and Selling the following items at 126% - Frost resist and health potion
Reached Level 3

Of course, there may be more efficient shoppe keepers out there than myself, and there may be some who are not as experienced, so these numbers are an estimate of what you can expect.

Additionally, I did not complete any quests in the above test, these will give you large amounts of K points upon completion too.

We hope you enjoy this small update, we will be away during the Christmas period so once again, have a Merry Christmas and a happy new year from all of the team here.

notes.title: One More Day Until Shoppe Keep's Update Launches (NOW LIVE)
notes.notes:
Tomorrow will see some significant changes to Shoppe Keep. A lot of the changes were made to improve upon the progression of the core game. We are hoping that these changes really encourage players to keep playing as they unlock new and exciting stuff over time.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/lTeVrRR.png[/img]

To achieve this we have enhanced the skill tree, which will allow players to buy new tiered items, encourage different classes to visit your shoppe, unlock the adventurer class and adjust how customers treat your shoppe with regards to profit margins. We are looking forward to seeing what skills players unlock first and how best to strategize with the new skill system.

We have made some additional changes to the customers too. A major change is an adjustment in what percentage of profit customers will purchased at, customers are now a little more financially strapped and won’t pay for a product at a 300% mark up.

There is also some changes to how customer demand for specific items is handled. As you sell a wooden shield to a customer, the game will remember what items they bought. If they still have it equipped when they return to the shoppe, they will choose not to buy another wooden shield. The items customers purchase will however damage over time, so they will eventually return to buy another wooden shield from you.

[img]https://scontent-lhr3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xfl1/t31.0-8/920668_492257034292527_3421418980634926984_o.png[/img]

With the way we’re handling the skill tree, the quest system is now more important than ever before. To unlock skills in the skill tree you need K Points, these can be naturally earned by selling items and ordering items. However quests no longer offer money, instead they offer a significant amount of k points which you can use to unlock new skills. These quests refresh in the morning, mid-day and evening and it is highly recommended to keep checking to see if there are any quests you can complete with your current inventory.

I would also like to take this moment to welcome our new artist Andrea Di Bartolo who has been working very hard on a lot of the new items and the external outside area for Shoppe Keep. We hope you all enjoy the work he has put into the game.

Below is a list of things that you can expect when the update launches tomorrow:

- Refurbished visuals
- New spell
- Lots of new items to buy/sell/craft/gain
- Tiered order scroll
- 37 Skills/Upgrades/Unlocks
- Progression gameplay
- Barbarians with Santa hats
- Exterior City
- No man’s land unlocked (Backdoor garden)
- Vinyl player with up to 20 Original songs to spruce up your game play (10 special Christmas songs)
- Champion who finally learned how to gain XP and level up!
- A way to cut down dirt production from customers in half! 
- Preventing plants from wilting
- Tier 2 class helmets and shoulders
- Customer eye colour
- Personal chest to store your items for later

And of course there are a few other things that have probably been added and even we struggle to remember what has even been added! 

We do recommend that when the update launches, it would be best to clear your save data and reset the progress in the options menu. The way we’ve handled the skill trees may mean that there is a chance it will cause some issues for players using their old save data. 

We have also adjusted some of the recipes. If a recipe earlier had requested a litre of Metal, it will require a metal bar instead.  The same is done for gold too. To create a bar you will need 4x liquid metal/ gold.

Fuel however is a little different as the recipe will be: Metal Bar + Junk + Metal litre + Junk

And finally, we would like to stress that the tutorials will be thoroughly updated soon. We have some interesting ideas as to what to do with these tutorials and we understand they are out of date. However, if you are stuck in any way, we do have an awesome community who will be able to help in the forums and some very good wiki pages too. We have also added a Wiki link inside the game on the main menu too!

That’s it, tomorrow will be a big update and it’s just one more sleep before you all get to play it! Watch the video below for just a sneak peek of what is coming tomorrow.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KifV6Bn2cLE

And finally, we would like to stress that the tutorials will be thoroughly updated soon. We have some interesting ideas as to what to do with these tutorials and we understand they are out of date. However, if you are stuck in any way, we do have an awesome community who will be able to help in the forums and some very good wiki pages too. We have also added a Wiki link inside the game on the main menu too!

That’s it, tomorrow will be a big update and it’s just one more sleep before you all get to play it! Watch the video below for just a sneak peek of what is coming tomorrow.

notes.title: Introducing A Tier System
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/JLdDyrz.jpg[/img]

That's a rogue class equipped with some awesome Tier 2 items. What does this mean? let me explain below!

One of the things we wanted to do in Shoppe keep is bring in a sense of progression that allowed players to unlock particular items steadily to improve their shoppe. The skill tree has been the focus for this week, be it unlocking the back garden or unlocking a Gramophone.

When the update goes live later this month, players will begin with some bare essentials and a few warrior items. But, as they begin to spend their skill points, they will unlock different items for different classes. 

Along with this is a new second tier item set that features a selection of different weapons that players can sell. These are entirely new items and we'll make sure to share just a few of them ahead of the full release. 

Let us know what you think of the Rogues new tier 2 duds and weapon!

notes.title: I'm Holding Out For A Hero 'Til The... Latter Half of December
notes.notes:

The champion system has been around for a little while and we have made a few changes to it since it was made live. When the update launches, the adventurer will be unlocked via the skill tree and come with a small but important feature... They will level up.

Should your champion fall in battle, they will still earn XP towards their next level.

notes.title: Changes To The Forums, Introducing A New Team Member & A Small Tease
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

As we begin to approach the year 2016, we want to leap into the new year with a small subtle change to how we track bugs and suggestions.

We have a lot of posts in those forums and a lot of things to go through. A lot of issues are reported several times by different players and we want to do our best to make this more manageable and easier for us to track everything. 

So, we have created two new sub forums... At the moment they are labelled

"December 2015 Bugs"

&

"December 2015 suggestions"

Essentially this is a clean slate from which we can truly look at what issues are currently in the game, and what suggestions have been made regarding the most up to date builds. Please post all suggestions and bugs in these forums from now on.

In January, we shall then create January sub forums to continue to keep things up to date. This will do two things, help us track issues, and also allow new players to see what type of issues are currently in the game.

Additionally, we have had a new member join the team over the past month who has been helping us test several games including Shoppe Keep. He will be present in the forums to respond to questions and track issues reported by the community. So in a week or so, you may see a new member with the 'Developer' tag next to his name. 

And finally, regarding actual game updates. We're working on a pretty substantial update to release in December and we're hoping to reveal some details early December. We're hoping you'll enjoy what we have planned!

All the best,
Chris

notes.title: ChangeLog 11.18
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

New update has launched for Shoppe Keep with a few changes and fixes. We have changed how players will be able to open their shoppe, now you will need to be looking at and standing near to the door and then press the E key. No more accidental openings! 

[h1]ChangeLog 11.18[/h1]
[list][*]Adjusted how Barbingtua spawns
[*]Fixed an issue where the inventory sorter to the far right would not scroll when you had a lot of items in your inventory
[*]Changed crafting UI so players can tell the difference between certain crafting materials
[*]Players will now need to be standing near the door and pressing the E key to open the shoppe.[/list]

We are still in the prototyping stages for the helper bot. He may become unresponsive at times but we are definitely looking into this and he will become much more helpful in the future.

This is a relatively small update but we have also been working on some performance as well. We have some really interesting things planned for the future and will share more news soon!

notes.title: Content ID Issue - Disputing Copyright Claims
notes.notes:

notes.title: Performance in Shoppe Keep (Try this everyone who has crashing issues)
notes.notes:
NOTE: Latest build uploaded 00:20 GMT on 16th November 2015,  fixed issues that caused crashes on lower end GPU'S that do not support DX 11

[h1]Good day, morning or even evening![/h1]

As most of you know and maybe are suffering from performance drops in the game. We have introduced visual sliders, ability to toggle off indoor shadows, but it seems like we are still not there yet! As me and the people who are testing the game do not feel any significant FPS loss it is a tricky situation when trying to deal and find which part of the game is at fault. So I have come to a conclusion after a sleepless night trying to figure out what is the problem. Just for this specific issue that I will from now on put a lot of attention to, I have created a "Performance" branch in the game, meaning if you right click on the game in your Steam library and select properties>>Betas and opt into the Performance branch you will be issued a build specifically for this experiment. Why do we need a separate build? As not to interfere with the main public live builds that most of the people are enjoying, in case we brake something while trying to catch the issue. Now at the time of this announcement I have uploaded builds into the Performance branch, anyone and everyone who has experienced slowdowns in the game, please try that specific build and tell me if you feel an improvement of is the issue greater than thought. This will help me make the game a more enjoyable experience for you and all the community. Me and my team love our fans and we do not wish to disappoint!

[img]http://s22.postimg.org/u4skrxgxt/Betas.jpg[/img]

-Arvydas

notes.title: ChangeLog 11.12
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are back with a new update for Shoppe Keep. There are some quite drastic changes which will begin to affect gameplay over the coming weeks and months. 

Among these are some changes to the Helper bot who will now require fuel to run. The helper bot can also begin to restock items placed inside its chest. However right now the helper bot will set anything it places in the shoppe to 100%.... Right now this is a prototype, in time you will be able to set the price helper bots will sell items for. Feel free to test this out and let us know what you think!

The Grinder has been upgraded visually, check it out here:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/u6sjcIe.jpg[/img]

And the cauldron has a new UI when using the F key too

[img]http://i.imgur.com/t5kVj4s.png[/img]

We have also added a brand new item in the back room. The grill. This has its uses that we’re letting you discover!

[h1]ChangeLog 11.12[/h1]
[list][*]Added the ability to allow bots to restock items (This is in prototyping phase, unfortunately bots will set items to sell for 100% so we recommend only using this if you’d like to test)
[*]Bots now require fuel for all actions.
[*]1 new recipe added
[*]Made some adjustments to UI
[*]Improved the grinder and added signs to the tubes
[*]Added a brand new grill
[*]New cauldron UI menu for crafting items
[*]Added an inventory sorting window which can allow you to change the rotation order of items in shoppe keeper mode. This is still in prototyping phase
[*]Some work done to increase performance[/list]

Good luck in discovering the new recipe! As usual, if you have any issues to report, let us know

All the best,
Chris

notes.title: Content ID Issue - Will Be Resolved Very Soon
notes.notes:
Update:

Further details can be found here: http://steamcommunity.com/games/381120/announcements/detail/746831411318807958

Original announcement:

Hi everyone,

We wanted to share some news on an issue that has appeared last night. Our musician Daniel Romeros has been looking to get an official soundtrack prepared for Shoppe Keep. He has been working very hard, creating new scores and in time we will share details of the official soundtrack.

Unfortunately a third party system for copyrighting the music was used and has led to the third party setting up content ID. Content ID for those who are not aware will search for videos on YouTube and issue a copyright claim which results in advertisements being played in videos.

This was set up completely accidentally and as we are very open about our development process, we wanted to let everyone know that this is not a system we intended to use and have contacted all parties involved to remove this system immediately.

We understand that this may cause issues on some channels but it is now our priority to completely remove this as we do not support this blanket content ID system. We are just awaiting further information from the third party 

For now, if you’d like to continue monetising your videos on YouTube, I will recommend turning the music off in the options menu. I will update this announcement when the issue has been resolved.

Apologies for those affected. But we hope to resolve this issue as soon as possible.

notes.title: ChangeLog 10.26
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

We have some quite big changes to shoppe keep. We hope you enjoy it.

Not sure how to handle your stock rotation? The board out back now has a brand new ‘What’s hot’ list where it will tell you the most requested items for each class type. These change every five minutes and you will need to make sure that you stock these items to make the most cash.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9TtslSU.jpg[/img]

Your shoppes exterior has changed slightly, based on your steam name and avatar picture, the game will place a large sign on the outside advertising your shoppe

[img]http://i.imgur.com/dOxknJD.jpg[/img]

A new sellable item is available, the magic wand

[img]http://i.imgur.com/CmPP12f.jpg[/img]

There are also three new recipes added to the game. Considering you guys have found the last recipes in hours, we are anticipating the community’s discovery on what the new crafted items will be. If you have not discovered the recipes by next week, we shall share some clues.
Also a variety of other fixes and changes

[h1]ChangeLog 10.26[/h1]
[list][*]Added a new sign to the outside of the shoppe
[*]1 new item to order, three new item recipes added. Totaling four new items to sell
[*]Added a visual quality slider in the options menu representing Low/ Medium and high quality
[*]Customers now get scared if you damage another person or object
[*]Added “hot” list to the board in the backroom which shows items in high demand for each period of the day
[*]When scrolling through items, there is now visual feedback to show what item you will be scrolling towards

notes.title: ChangeLog 10.20 - Save Issue
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are releasing a small update today that we hope will eliminate the save issue that players are reporting. 

We played the latest patch across 45 consecutive days and didn’t experience an issue with saving. So we are hoping this bug has been completely eliminated. However, do please let us know if you are still experiencing issues.

However, there is a small issue that happens as a result of this fix, the days may last only five minutes. This is an issue we’re looking to fix soon, but we would really like to eliminate the lesser of two evils (the save bug)
The change log includes

[h1]ChangeLog 10.20[/h1]
[list][*]Added a notification that will let you know you can talk to customers
[*]Dirt appears much slower
[*]Floor matts have a longer life
[*]You can now place weapon rack items on tables and counters.
[*]The weapon rack is now used for holding larger weapon types
[*]You are able to name your champion
[*]Update to the Adventure system; each adventure now has named mobs, bosses and different drops[/list]

Finally, I’d like to ask a point of view from the community as the game continues to evolve and we add new content.

Would you rather see bigger updates that happen once a week, or would you like updates roll out whenever a feature is working (though may need more work & balancing). The reason for this is because the game is pretty heavy in development as many of you are aware and it would be good to see the expectations from the community in terms of updates etc.

All the best,
Chris

notes.title: Phase 2 Launches - Update available now
notes.notes:
Today marks our last announcement and the beginning of the phase 2 development stage for Shoppe Keep. The price has increased by just a couple of dollars and we hope that you all join us during Phase 2 of development. We have just one more silhouette to uncover so take a look below

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Yt5hf1r.jpg[/img]

This armour set is a little different than many of the other sets we’ve revealed earlier this week. Introducing the bone armour. A very sturdy armour type that requires others to lose their lives, so that you can protect yours. 

The developer Arvydas has shared with us this screenshot which may provide you with some hints on how to craft this special Bone Armour

[img]http://i.imgur.com/3TL9gm7.jpg[/img]

Additionally, this warrior is carrying a rather dangerous sword, which can be created using Alchemy. In total there are 29 different recipes to craft. So I’m looking forward to users sharing their experiments in the crafting system over the next coming weeks in the steam forums.

The next feature we'd like to share is the Customer Browser which can be accessed on the main menu. The game will now remember the names of all customers that visit your shoppe, as well as details on what they purchased. Here is a screenshot from the customer browser:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Fn0sqWi.jpg[/img]

We have also implemented a new system that will let you recommend items to potential customers. They will often tell you what item they are going to look at so you can find a complimentary item to sell with that item. They may also refuse an item suggestion too.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/GNBPeU7.jpg[/img]

And finally, a part of the update includes prototyping of a new heavily requested feature. I must inform you that this feature is not final and we are hoping to make it a core part of the game, that system is...

[h1]Champion System[/h1]
Currently in prototyping stages, a champion will be in your back room. This adventurer can be sent out on quests to travel to dungeons, defeat enemies and bring back special items. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Wjvf6LZ.jpg[/img]

When a champion returns from an adventure, they will come back with a log of details, showing you all of the fights they had on their journey and what happened at the end. This is currently akin to a text adventure.

The champion system will eventually be a part of the core gameplay and will go through quite a lot of changes. But we understand that this was a heavily requested feature and we would like you all to be a part of the development process for this system. So let us know your thoughts, make some requests and we will be happy to discuss many points in the forums.

There is just one more thing that we are working on. Anyone who has an Early Access achievement will be able to unlock the golden axe.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/rhP9j37.png[/img]

[h1]The Gold Plated Axe[/h1]
The Gold-plated Axe… Some say the item was forged inside a volcano by a mad goldsmith who was adamant that higher temperatures enhanced quality of weaponry, he of course perished in the volcano but if true he made a sweet axe! 

There are also rumours that say that it was crafted from the tooth of a legendary giant that destroyed three cities, a farm and several dozen road signs causing a logistical nightmare for the transport industry. 

But what is known for certain is that the Shoppe Keeper is the only man who can wield this devastating weapon.

[b]Features[/b]
•	An Axe
•	Gold Plated
•	Combines the qualities of being an axe and also being gold plated
•	Comfortable grip
•	Stainless steel
•	Lifetime guarantee - The blade will never dull

notes.title: Phase 2 Launches - Update available now
notes.notes:
Today marks our last announcement and the beginning of the phase 2 development stage for Shoppe Keep. The price has increased by just a couple of dollars and we hope that you all join us during Phase 2 of development. We have just one more silhouette to uncover so take a look below

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Yt5hf1r.jpg[/img]

This armour set is a little different than many of the other sets we’ve revealed earlier this week. Introducing the bone armour. A very sturdy armour type that requires others to lose their lives, so that you can protect yours. 

The developer Arvydas has shared with us this screenshot which may provide you with some hints on how to craft this special Bone Armour

[img]http://i.imgur.com/3TL9gm7.jpg[/img]

Additionally, this warrior is carrying a rather dangerous sword, which can be created using Alchemy. In total there are 29 different recipes to craft. So I’m looking forward to users sharing their experiments in the crafting system over the next coming weeks in the steam forums.

The next feature we'd like to share is the Customer Browser which can be accessed on the main menu. The game will now remember the names of all customers that visit your shoppe, as well as details on what they purchased. Here is a screenshot from the customer browser:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Fn0sqWi.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/GNBPeU7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 2 Days Until Phase 2 Launches
notes.notes:
We are just a couple of days away from the launch of our first major update to Shoppe Keep. So without further ado, let’s reveal another silhouette. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/CPL5uqu.jpg[/img]

This gold armour was created via the method of Alchemy. In the back room, players will also find some new additions. First, they will see the grinder, a specially created mechanical device that can grind any material into liquid.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/bDSJpcy.jpg[/img]

Putting items into the grinder will turn it into liquefied material. Depending on the item it will turn into either wood, metal, gold, mirr, junk or bone... These will be placed into the tubes, and you’ll be able to gather the materials from the taps.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/CLvLKoX.jpg[/img]

And finally, we have the cauldron. From the cauldron you are able to place a variety of items in order to create new items. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/FKUeOB4.jpg[/img]

You will need to place a selection of items and liquid materials into the cauldron. If you uncover the correct recipe, the item will appear above the cauldron.  We will be keeping an eye on the forums at launch to see how players are finding this system

notes.title: ChangeLog 09.15 - Plus An Experiment!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Some small fixes for Shoppe Keep today.

[h1]Changelog 09.15[/h1]
•	Fixed an issue where bots would not work
•	Fixed an issue where when rugs placed near book shelves, it was difficult to place items on the lower two shelves
•	Started work on new customer interaction, though not functional completely. Press F when near a customer for a small preview.

We are aware of a new issue brought in the last patch where customers will not purchase an item if another customer purchased the item they were originally going for. We are looking into this.

[h1]An Experiment[/h1]
I’d like to propose a small experiment. Anyone’s involvement would really be awesome! Please try to do the following:

[list][*]Reset your skills & delete my shoppe save data
[*]Play as best as you can (unlocking skills, placing new furniture at the end of the day) all the way up to the end of Day five.
[*]Once you reach the morning of day six, take a screenshot of your statistics and share it with us in the forums via steams screenshot (pressing F12 while in game). I’d really like to see how players progress and what sort of money they can make in the first six days.[/list]

This will really help us in terms of seeing how fast players grow their Shoppe and see how best we can balance the progress of gameplay. 

I’ll start, here are my first 5 days statistics using the most recent patch. Obviously, I need to keep a better eye on thieves as over half of them in the first 5 days seem to have scampered off with goods from my shoppe.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/JtmVeRs.jpg[/img]

There may even be a reward for you all in game who do this. Try your best to post your screenshot URL in the comments of this announcement so I can track who is helping us out with all of this. Anyone’s assistance on this really would help us with this.

All the best,
Chris

notes.title: ChangeLog 09.11
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

A new build has gone live! A few things have been addressed and fixed that we hope you enjoy. If you experience any issues, do let us know!

First, some of you may open up your save games and see Exclamation marks above some furniture... If this happens, this means that a customer is having trouble getting to that piece of furniture and you will need to remove it. this should prevent customers from sticking.

Additionally, some objects have had their collision reworked, hopefully this means when building new items, you won;t have the above issue happen anyway. These should fix sticking customers & end of day issues where the door no longer closes!

There are also a few other changes:

[h1]ChangeLog 09.11[/h1]
[list][*]Modern broom now has sweeping animation
[*]The Shoppe no longer opens if the player has not got a single piece of furniture in their shoppe
[*]Added text above the door to tell new players to enter build mode to place furniture
[*]Fixed an issue where FPS dropped when a large number of customers ran out of the shoppe
[*]Rotated the delivery chest 90 degrees
[*]Added an option to turn off the simulated breathing in the options menu
[*]When in any mode (Except build mode) players can hit Q twice to quickly bring up the order scroll.
[*]Some work done on path finding (see above explanations)[/list]

Hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.title: ChangeLog 09.04 - Scenarios Added To My Shoppe Mode
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

We have a new update today which includes a few fixes and one returning feature.

We recently locked out scenarios as we felt like incorporating them into the My shoppe experience. That has now been done in its first form. So you can now accept quests which will reward you with bonus cash upon completion! In the future perhaps these quests will unlock new items or customization options, but for now, this is a quick implementation.

Every day you can choose between three random quests. Just open up the statistics window, click on quest and then select the quest you'd like to complete. Now, when pressing the Escape key, your quest log will appear on the left of the screen.

Please note, that progress of quests are not saved when you quit the game.

Full patch notes below:

[h1]ChangeLog 09.04[/h1]
[list][*]Quests/objectives
[*]Some work done on customer path finding
[*]weapon rack can be removed
[*]Some work done to improve saving feature
[/list]

Many thanks!
Chris

notes.title: ChangeLog 09.02
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Otto Otterman here!

First, let me say it's great to meet everyone, it's my first announcement here! It is a long one, but we have a lot of work to do, so let's get down to it!

A new update has gone live for Shoppe Keep and we needed to share some key info on this latest update as it brings with it a few changes and lays the groundwork for future features.

First, we have redesigned the back room with just a few tiny additions. The first of which is a boarded up door leading to the outside world. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/zwO6Wde.gif[/img]

You all had a brief taste of exploring outside when a bug had entered the game a week ago. And because of this we are looking at ways the player can leave the shoppe with some duties.  For example, through this door we will lead to a few things in future updates including:

[list]
    [*]A pet breeding ground to manage
    [*]Players personal housing which you can decorate
    [*]The ability to grow more types of items
[/list]

Note: these three bullet points are not yet in the game, but we are working on them!

The stock room has also received a new decoration, the bust of your dear old grandfather who owned the shoppe before you. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9G9eBoP.gif[/img]

We have also added a physical player model. If you look down you will see…

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Lig8CJz.gif[/img]

We have also brought forward a piece content from the development roadmap, the module shoppe. Right now, this means that you are able to upgrade your shoppe in the statistics window in game. This means that you can unlock a larger part of your shoppe and expand fully. This was done to begin work on the AI, which will be mproved upon. But we really needed to work on module shoppe sooner to factor in how AI will move in a larger environment.

Because of the way this new My Shoppe works, it is highly recommended that you delete your old save as it may cause some issues. Unfortunately, this is the demon of Games development as things change, and things get lost, but we really appreciate all of the help you’ve given us in this process.
Check out this image of one side of the shop expanded! There’s still the centre and the other side to expand upon

[img]http://i.imgur.com/OpOK6xM.jpg[/img]

That leads us to the customers. Currently we have two new commands. Pressing the F key will allow you to interact with the customers via a speech bubble and will show a line of the route they are currently on...

If customers get stuck, press the J key, this will initiate a reset and allow customers to leave the area. With a large amount of customers you may need to press the J key several times. This is mainly implemented to allow players who are unable to save due to customers not leaving the shoppe at the end of the day in My Shoppe mode.

We also have a new broom to unlock in customisation and a couple of new plants to grow!

Finally, we realised a lot of these additions really take into affect on My Shoppe mode so we will be changing how My Shoppe mode works in the future. Let me take some time to explain just a little bit about how this will work.

My Shoppe mode will behave very similar to a freeplay mode where players can build their own shoppe and make money. However, in time the Quest system (Taken from scenarios) will be implemented into the daily task of the shoppe keeper. This means that while playing My Shoppe, you will be able to complete additional quests above and beyond basic maintenance of your shoppe for additional rewards. Essentially, we want the core game to provide players with the flexibility of building anything they like with the added benefit of accepting additional tasks for new rewards. We feel that merging both scenarios with my shoppe will allow for a greater and more exciting personal experience as you can build and maintain your own shoppe instead of being given a designated shoppe layout.

We have unchecked the scenarios for now so that we can focus on the My Shoppe mode. We really want to expand on this and hope you all look forward to a more fluid game experience as the two modes become one.

Most of this update is focused on the upcoming Module shoppe (which was originaly scheduled for October) so this is really a build up to new features and new additions.

A list of all changes for this build are as follows:

[h1]ChangeLog 09.02[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can see yourself when you look down
[*]Customer AI engine made from scratch (Some bugs may appear, but we got two buttons to squash them out!)
[*]Pressing F while looking at a customer will initiate a small Chat meaning he will tell you what he is trying to do, and will show a trail of his next destination
[*]Pressing J will override all customers into rethinking their path, ultimately unsticking them if the code does not unstick them on its own.
[*]Customers have dialogs ranging from browsing to unhappy, to scared and basic random chat
[*]Trying to jump is once again talked down on the player, literally talked.
[*]The shop has unlockable zones which can be unlocked for 10k gold each in the shop statistics window
[*]A new broom in the customization panel
[*]You can unlock the outside backroom, but it is a WIP, future place for pet breeding and a personal player house.
[*]Bust of your grandfather who owned the shop before you in the back room
[*]Scenarios locked out to adapt to the new shop layout.
[*]Price changes with 9 and 0 keys.
[*]Grow Mush and Weed
[/list]
It’s been a great first couple of weeks, thanks for all the support everyone!

notes.title: ChangeLog 08.26
notes.notes:
Last night we released a new patch and several quick hot fixes! While we have another update coming very soon with brand new customization features, the change log for last nights patch are below:

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
 [*]Fixed placement of armour racks in Scenario 1
 [*]Motion blur automatically set to off for new users. Can turn it on in the options menu if wanted
 [*]International keyboard issues – Keys ([) and (]) increase and decrease price now
 [*]Fixed an issue where text was covered in the building tutorial by an image
 [*]Book case in stock room no longer has the properties of a super natural spirit and cannot be walked through.
 [*]Players can no longer escape the shoppe
 [*]The interest fees perk now has a 25% chance to receive a pay-out from customer instead of being active on every single customer.
 [*]Adjusted the way the game quits which should prevent a crash when quitting the game.
 [*]Fixed an exploit where players would kill innocent customers after purchasing an item to retrieve that item back… But this exploit may return with some consequences in the future ;)
 [*]Renamed Rare wish to –The Sword of Barbingantua
 [*]Engineering items more popular to customers
 [*]Fewer Barbarians (except for scenario 1)
 [*]Customers More likely to buy cheaper items
 [*]Scenarios should now progress in correct order
 [*]Using the watch in My Shoppe now correctly charges you gold to do so
 [*]Notifications now last a little longer
 [*]Fixed Scenario other town – Where warrior items did not sell
 [*]Fixed an issue where when purchasing the second portal upgrade, it does not work until you exit the game.
 [*]Fixed  an issue where the game crashes when exiting the game – let us know if you have any issues with this still!
 [*]Fixed an issue where customers would not spawn in Scenario 17
 [*]Fixed an issue where customers would launch you into the air when they walk through you. (Added new path finding system)
 [*]Fixed a counter that caused customers to get stuck in Scenario 13
 [*]Scenario 7 is no longer a duplicate of Scenario 6!
[/list]
[h1]Shoppe Keep additions[/h1]
[list]
 [*]When holding left shift in Order scrolls menu, players can purchase ten times the amount per click
 [*]When setting a price for an item and dropping that particular item, all previously placed exact items will match that price – No more picking up of all items individually to change price
 [*]In the lower left corner, a timer has been added to count down upon next Shoppe appeal inspection and the next round of tax
 [*]Added a note in the description of missions explaining that a fraction of profits will go towards Tax. 
 [*]Shoppe Appeal rating now appears on the top left when opening up the order scroll
 [*]My Shoppe Mode now begins with all items unlocked. With the next update, players who complete scenarios will be given an extra reward!
 [*]Added a door mat in My Shoppe mode which prevents each customer that walks on it to track dirt into your shoppe. This door mat cannot be repaired, so you will have to wait until end of day to replace it if it gets destroyed.
 [*]Added new pathfinding system for AI where customers will attempt to walk around you if you block their path
[/list]

notes.title: Shoppe Keep Has Launched - The Development Road-map
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Shoppe Keep has just launched on Steam! You can pick it up for the low price of just $4.99 with an additional launch week discount of 10%. We’d like to take this moment to thank everyone for getting involved and please get in touch with us to discuss your thoughts and suggestions. We are active in the steam forums and we are planning to work very hard on the game.

We do have a development roadmap in the forums that will continue to be updated during development, but the initial roadmap is as follows:

[h1]Ongoing regular updates[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixes
    [*]New items
    [*]New Scenarios[/list]

[h1]Customisation[/h1]
[b]Estimated release: 28th August to 4th September[/b]
Your old leather gloves are starting to wear? Tired of seeing the same old chest of goodies pop up? All the blood on your sword is staining the steel? Do not worry! Spend your coin on new swords, axes, hammers, brooms, chests, hats, even learn new spells and more! Customise yourself to the fullest!

[h1]Crafting[/h1]
[b]Estimated release 11th September to 18th September[/b]
Some of the items you like to sell, some you might want to drop into a grinder in the back room and enjoy the gurgle of elements. What you get out of this are the core materials that item was made up with, throw those materials with some other items into the cauldron and wish for the best! Those old alchemy geezers will have a new expert on the block - You.

[h1]Modular Shoppe[/h1]
[b]Estimated release: 11th October to 18th October[/b]
A modular shoppe will allow the players to spend their hard earn coin in breaking down walls of their shop and expanding it, unlocking not only bigger spaces for their customers to roam and choose items, but some new functionality as well!

notes.title: Change Log #4 - Combat, Rats & Skeletons
notes.notes:
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/deadbarb.PNG[/img]

Welcome to the fourth historic change log breakdown. We had a lot of fun developing the combat state of Shoppe Keep. With it, combat led to some interesting design decisions. You can read the full Article at http://www.indiedb.com/games/shop-keep

So the two change logs that we are referencing this week are:

[h1]ChangeLog 05.24[/h1]

- Combat state let's you damage objects, kill customers
- Skeletons now have to be removed with a broom or face an impact on shop appeal
- Trash piles spawn when an object is destroyed, remove with broom
- Customers bleed when hit, if killed ragdolls and you have to use the broom
- Object hit FX
- Blood FX
- Barbarians attack the player
- Shooting a spell drains mana, wait to recharge it
- Player health recharges
- Dead barbarians/Customers eyes change
- Once a barbarian has spawned every customer, thief, havoc, innocent will just run out of the shop for their lives, kill barbarians to restore order.
- To spawn barbarians press O (For debugging purposes for now)
- Once a barbarian is damaged by the player (Sword damage works for now) all of them will gang up on the player
- Knockout animation and state done
- Barbarians want to destroy every display object in the store, after none are left, they will leave
- Havoc customer now can become any class, he will have a 1 in 25 chance to make a spawned customer want to knock off items
- Bots should now behave properly even with the dirt on the ground
- Barbarians drop their sword, you can not buy it, but you can sell it

[h1]ChangeLog 05.29[/h1]

- Objects will "flinch" when hit by a repair hammer or damaged
- Rats spawn in junk piles and will dirty the floor
- New Central UI Button:Statistics
- Statistics panel shows appeal and the causes that lower it including:
Body,Skeleton, Junk pile count and a progress bar of how dirty is the floor
- Specularity in objects as a test
- Animated menu buttons
- Shop size choice (The system is here, will be used when more shops come)
- Reworked the start of free mode
- Moved the "Press E to open shop" in a more appropriate place
- Barbarians spawn each time 100 customers spawn
- We have another lose condition - Shop Appeal
- 4 Time phases in free mode (Build,Morning,Day,Evening)
- Skip time phases with M(Debug reasons the cost is 0 gold, so skip away)
- Debug reasons Build mode has 0 SPM, Morning 50 SPM,Day 38 SPM, Evening 12 SPM
- A watch...Yeh, state 5 (Press 5 to check your watch)

Here was the very first screenshot taken of the combat state. Letting players wield a sword and a lightning spell:
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/Combat.PNG[/img]

Originally, skeletons would dissolve when the player zapped enemies. However, we found that perhaps skeletons should affect shop appeal, so players would need to remove them otherwise the shoppe would have a decrease in appeal, resulting in a loss in customer footfall.

You probably don't want your shoppe looking like this:

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/aftermath3.PNG[/img]

This change log introduced the barbarians! Spawning in packs, they would sought to destroy your shoppe, resulting in damaged store shelves. If left to their dastardly deeds, your shoppe will be at their mercy. However if the player chooses to defend their shoppe, they will attack the player and attempt to knock them out. The player will fall and the barbarians will then continue thier rampage on store objects

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/002.jpg[/img]

This build also included a tiny bit of polishing to give the player better feedback that their shop was being repaired. This just meant adding a slight flinch when repairing a shoppe object

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/Flinch2.gif[/img]

Once an object is destroyed, it will become a pile of trash. This will then attract rats to your shoppe so it is wise to sweep the floor and get the shop clean again... Even though these fellas are adorable, your customers will not feel the same way

[img]http://i.imgur.com/VrC4lb1.gif[/img]

We also started work on creating a day cycle for free mode. The result of this was that certain parts of the day will have a higher footfall, but also meant that the evening/morning phases could be used to place tables and shelves in your shoppe. 

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/Watchx.PNG[/img]

That's the end of for these change logs! We have a lot more interesting things to share, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Change Log #3 - Dirty customers, trailer filming, object durability and more!
notes.notes:
Welcome back! Let us continue our adventure into the past of Shoppe Keep changelogs going back to May. You can see the full article on Indie DB at - [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/shop-keep/news/shoppe-keep-changelog-part-3]Shoppe Keep Changelog Part 3 [/url]

The change logs we will be discussing today are:

[h1]Change Log 05.16:[/h1]
- Bot is finished and needs extensive tests
- Customer become skeletons on death and dissipate over time
- For us devs, press K for lots and lots of XP giving thousands of Keep Points
- Pressing I will toggle the main UI on/off

[h1]Change Log 05.19:[/h1]
- Pressing P will toggle phasing through objects and walls
- Left Shift and Left Control raises and lowers the main camera
- WIP durabilit in place but turned off for debugging

[h1]Change Log 05.20:[/h1]
- Customers dirty the floor where they walk
- 1,2,3,4 buttons change the players state
- Q and E buttons are context buttons:
      Shop Keep state - Q opens central UI, E Opens shop
      Builder State - Rotates object left and right
      Cleaner State - Q selects Broom, E selects Hammer

- Dirt Directly influences the appeal of the shop, a clean shop + 30% skill gives you an overhead of 130% appeal
- Object durability suffers from items being placed, taken, and knocked off. A decrease to 80% durability will start to make customers ignore items on the object.
- A chaotic customer now sometimes runs in and knocks some items off  their objects. Deal with it!
- Broom and hammer functionality, no visuals or sounds as of yet.

The first two days consist mostly of some additions to help with filming the trailer and fast debugging of features which require KP or noclipping. For example this helped us find a cluster of customers right around the corner and fix it, potentially saving a lot of CPU cycles.

The first introduction of a customer becoming a skeleton when zapped. This is pre combat state days. Do not mind the generic YouTube music as the developer was listening to a podcast and forgot that it will be recorded with the sound. Skeletons did have a change in their visuals and behaviour later on but this is the basic start for them.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oD2-6vlvhKg

[h1]Basic durability for objects[/h1]
Durability has 3 states for each placed object. (Not products that you sell but the display cases, pedestals, racks etc, etc.):

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/newScreen.PNG[/img]


Ideal (100-60%)
Worn (60-40%)
Critical (40-5%)
When an object is ideal it will act as a normal object. Customers will be interested in them, buy from them, browse items in/on them, everything as usual.
Worn objects start to look a bit broken. Although customers still notice items in them, they tend to request a discount and in turn you always agree (Fix up your stuff man.)
Critical objects means that it will start deteriorating at a steady rate looking even more worn and broken.
This feature had upgrades over the next few days following its creation and we will get back to it when further change logs appear.


[h1]Now onto May 20th:[/h1]
Shoppe Keep got a player state feature long overdue to save up those buttons and make controls a bit easier on the player.

When pressing 1 you are in a traditional shop keeper state in which you can order items, place them, remove them,
increase the margin, check stats for the shop, unlock skills and control the bots.

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/006.jpg[/img]

When pressing 2 you go into the Builder state. Moving, selling, buying and rotating objects.

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/build.PNG[/img]

Pressing 3 enters you into the Cleaning and Fixing state. You get two items: a hammer and a broom to clean and fix.

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/clean2.PNG[/img]

Pressing 4 was a mute state at that moment but it is our future Combat state!

Customers tend to wander around on their adventures on dirty paths, in filthy caves and this gets their shoes all grimy. This of course means they bring that dirt into your pristine shop lowering its appeal. Grab a broom at fix it quickly!

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/customerdirt.PNG[/img]

We added a wildcard customer which when spawned just runs in and creates chaos, knocks items off shelves, brings in dirt and just runs out. Something you just have to accept is that not all customers are normal people. It's almost a real life simulator at this state.

We hope you continue to enjoy these change logs. The game will continue to evolve up to the Early Access release and then continue to change even further with your help. We hope to also continue giving you as much information as possible before and during the Early Access release.
All the best.
Tim

notes.title: Change Log #2 - Portals, Helper Bots and UI's Oh My!
notes.notes:
Following from our earlier change log post, we are compiling several Chang e Logs into this announcement. For the full article check out Indie DB at http://www.indiedb.com/games/shop-keep/news/changelog-part-2

[img]https://trello-attachments.s3.amazonaws.com/54f6d315da0f47421822495f/553f2ec5d797b799d8aff6f4/1f2d32e7c65c1788f8702b87d2da93e3/botbot.gif[/img]

The three change logs included the following:

[h1]Change Log 0.5.10:[/h1]
- Bot has lift off, land, fly, zap sounds. 
- Hovering over placed item will bring out a WIP bubble with the items information 
- Old shield re textured + 2 new shields 
- Animated Central UI 
- Warriors want to buy the new shields

[h1]ChangeLog 05.12:[/h1]
- Refurbished UI with animations and new font's, visuals 
- Main Menu visuals reworked 
- Fountain particles and water splashes 
- Animated Portal 
- More options for changing visuals 
- The doors when opening emit dust

[h1]ChangeLog 05.13:[/h1]
- Scroll and hand camera has raised FOV from 60 to 70
- New mouse cursor
- New item icons for a refurbished UI
- Item icons show in item descriptions on hover, corner of UI when selected, Quest log and item order
- Filter by gold in order scroll
- New quest log
- Confirmation windows for quitting and unlocking skills
- Minor bug fixes and updates

First, let's talk about the Helper bot. We wanted him to have a selection of different sounds that would allow the player to know what this fella was up to without even seeing him. so we had flying, docking and traction beam sounds to bring him to life. 

During these change logs we also wanted to give the player more information on the items placed on stands so we created a pop up that would appear when inspecting an item. The original used to look like a speech bubble, but it now looks a little more refined, having an image of the item too.

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/looked.png[/img]

We had been using a shield from one of the teams other games 'Beneath' for a while. And on the 05.10 build we created a new shield for the game as well as an alternative skin. Introducing the Buckle Shield.

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/shields.png[/img]

We had briefly discussed the UI in the last news post but we had a lot of major changes for he UI system which included new fonts, a main menu, the order scroll included a filter by gold amount and a quest/objective log was refined. Here is just a small collage of the changes we have made

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/uichanges.png[/img]

And finaly, we wanted to icnrease the quality of the environment and had animated the portal inside the shoppe and the fountain outside.

[img]http://media.giphy.com/media/xTiTnAnJ9Vht0gAWuQ/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://trello-attachments.s3.amazonaws.com/5557644f9840ac09d8af672f/1249x697/da256e2bafb7ac19dda3b35053bc75e6/TimeofDay.gif[/img]

We hope you all are enjoying these change logs. the game has continued to evolve so much and we will be posting change logs up to the Early Access release where you will then be a part of the Live change logs! we hope to keep giving you as much info as possible during early access to 

All the best,
Chris

notes.title: Change Log #1 - The First Of Many
notes.notes:
Since the middle of April. Shoppe Keep has undergone some great changes. In fact, we have had nearly 30 change logs during that time. Over the coming weeks to launch we wanted to share some of the major change logs with you.

The team created an indie db blog post with full details of what was available in the very first change log. Check it out in full here: http://www.indiedb.com/news/changelog-part-1

[h1]Changelog #1:[/h1]
- Customers unhappy with the price, will knock the item out of it's place requiring the player or a bot to pick it back up.
- Test bot's can be bought like any other item for 0 gold at the bottom of the order list
- Test bot's dock can be placed by pressing V to enter object placement in free mode, it is the last "Pole" type object
- Q is an all to go shop control button, it will bring up the usual order scroll and 3 new buttons in the left side (Placeholder)
- Skills button opens and closes the skill window
- Bot's button will be grayed out if no bots are found on docks in the scene, when at least 1 bot exists you will be presented with a scrollable window showing a panel for each bot and 3 buttons to change its state (Currently only gathering works), on the right side when hovering over a bot's panel you will be shown what that specific bot's dock lock box contains so you can go and pick them back up
- Stats button currently inactive
- Progress bar replaced with a 360 degree filling image in the center of the screen

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/thrown.png[/img]
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/helper_bots.png[/img]

notes.title: Change Log #1 - The First Of Many
notes.notes:
Since the middle of April. Shoppe Keep has undergone some great changes. In fact, we have had nearly 30 change logs during that time. Over the coming weeks to launch we wanted to share some of the major change logs with you.

The team created an indie db blog post with full details of what was available in the very first change log. Check it out in full here: http://www.indiedb.com/news/changelog-part-1

[h1]Changelog #1:[/h1]
- Customers unhappy with the price, will knock the item out of it's place requiring the player or a bot to pick it back up.
- Test bot's can be bought like any other item for 0 gold at the bottom of the order list
- Test bot's dock can be placed by pressing V to enter object placement in free mode, it is the last "Pole" type object
- Q is an all to go shop control button, it will bring up the usual order scroll and 3 new buttons in the left side (Placeholder)
- Skills button opens and closes the skill window
- Bot's button will be grayed out if no bots are found on docks in the scene, when at least 1 bot exists you will be presented with a scrollable window showing a panel for each bot and 3 buttons to change its state (Currently only gathering works), on the right side when hovering over a bot's panel you will be shown what that specific bot's dock lock box contains so you can go and pick them back up
- Stats button currently inactive
- Progress bar replaced with a 360 degree filling image in the center of the screen

notes.title: FROM NAKED RED MEN TO FANTASY SHOPPE KEEP
notes.notes:
Arvydas Žemaitis, developer of Shoppe Keep has been working Shoppe Keep for nearly five months. In that short time we’ve seen a lot of changes to the game and there will be many more to come. In an Indie DB article, we shared details of the zero build that was created at 3 AM on the 15th February 2015. (Full article here: http://www.indiedb.com/games/shop-keep/news/we-are-back-and-heres-some-news-about-more-news)

Zero build featured naked red men wandering around outside a shop. They would choose to enter if the player had an item that interested them, these items included graphics cards. From the foundations of Zero Build, Shoppe Keep was developed, the game re-focused its look to play on the fantasy RPG genre and allowed us to sell more interesting items like potions, swords and wizard hats. Check out the comparison gifs below to see how we’ve changed in just five months

[img]http://i.imgur.com/n4obNoy.gif[/img] [img]http://i.imgur.com/9M8LbFU.gif[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/mp8n74U.gif[/img] [img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3053/3052888/profile/compare4.gif[/img]

The work above was created thanks to Ian, a good friend of Arvydas who helped to shape the visual style of shoppe keep and focuses on asset creation. To bring all of the code and art together, Daniel joined shortly after, responsible for the music for Shoppe Keep and creating the sound effects in Shoppe Keep.

The team are continuing to work hard on the game up to its Early Access release in August. We’ll be starting the price at just $4.99 and we hope that you’ll join us to help make an awesome game!
